evidence.C1: The tank art is pleasant and the cream/green palette is coherent, but Garden and Journal look sparse and generic.
evidence.C2: Labelled tools, checklist and Cast button make main actions findable, but the phone toast overlaps status text.
evidence.C3: Care, fishing, breeding, scaping, greenhouse, reef genetics, orders, journal and focus are all present.
evidence.C4: Components are mostly consistent, but toast placement, Garden empty space and generic journal silhouettes show rough edges.

fixes: Reposition or stack toasts on 390px so they never cover tank status or checklist text.
Give Garden, Journal, Fishing and Focus the same designed art treatment as the tank, especially empty trays and journal silhouettes.
Add clearer next-step guidance and richer empty states on Garden/Journal/Focus so first-time users know what to do outside the tank.

evidence.C1: Coherent green/teal/beige palette and consistent serif+sans typography; tank art is pleasant but fish are simple vector shapes and the 'field-guide' aesthetic is only hinted at, not distinctive.
evidence.C2: Tools row clearly labelled (Feed/Care/Scape/Residents/Shop/Photo/Watch/Share), care sheet well-organised, fishing instructions like 'Hold to cast further' are clear; however on phone the 'My first tank is doing well' status section is clipped/overlapped by the toast and bottom nav.
evidence.C3: Multiple interlocking loops: nitrogen-cycle care, 9-spot fishing with weather/day-night and reel minigame (47 species, 5 rarities, golden variants), breeding with inherited colours, aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates, 3 tank sizes), greenhouse with variegated sports, reef lab with named strains, journal dex with silhouettes, focus timer with box breathing, daily orders, offline catch-up.
evidence.C4: Consistent dark-green accent, uniform cards/buttons/tabs across screens; rough edges include the phone status section being cut off behind the 'My first tank is ready' toast and the garden trays showing large empty placeholder areas that look unfinished.

fixes: Fix the 390 px tank layout so the 'My first tank is doing well' status panel is not clipped/overlapped by the toast and bottom navigation.
Give the empty garden trays a more designed empty state (subtle illustration, soil texture, or hint text) instead of large blank rectangles.

Strengthen the tank art toward a distinctive field-guide look — more detailed fish silhouettes, labelled plant species, or a subtle vignette — so the aquarium reads as the hero rather than a generic vector scene.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette with serif headings; tank art with light rays, layered plants and driftwood is the hero. But not every screen feels designed: the fishing scene is flat (plain sky, flat hills, bare rod) and the Garden screen is mostly empty below the four trays.
evidence.C2: Strong next-step cues: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', labelled tool row (Feed...Share), reel legend 'Fish / Your line, keep the fish inside / Catch progress', bait odds 'Cherry shrimp 16%'. Docked one point: on the phone the toast hides the water-quality status line, and Garden's next step after 'Plant' is less guided.
evidence.C3: Summary claims all anchor loops (nitrogen-cycle care, reel minigame, breeding with inherited colours, scaping, greenhouse, reef lab strains, orders, journal, focus) and screenshots confirm interlocks: 'Trimming gives cuttings to replant, sell or deliver', orders like 'Deliver 3 Water lettuce cuttings'. Breeding and reef genetics appear only in the summary, never on screen, so 'clearly exceed' is not fully demonstrated.
evidence.C4: Consistent cards, buttons and tabs across screens; disabled 'Deliver' states shown. Rough edge: the 'My first tank is ready' toast overlaps and obscures 'Water quality 99 of 100. Every fish is content' on the phone, and sits across the nav/content boundary on desktop.

fixes: Reposition toasts so they never cover content: on the phone the 'My first tank is ready' toast hides the water-quality status line; use a reserved non-overlapping slot or shorter auto-dismiss.
Raise the fishing scene and Garden screen to the tank's craft level: richer fishing art (sky/hills/water are flat) and a composed Garden layout instead of the large empty area below the trays.
Surface the deep loops in the UI itself - breeding, reef lab and scaping have no visible entry point or teaser in any screenshot, so the interlocking depth exists only in the summary text.
